payload.recallText:
"Whew!" Joe Matson whistles, his face bronze before turning to ask his sister something.

Clara was reading her own letter before look up at him. It was snowing all across the fields around them.

Joe explains he was let go from the Central Baseball league, Clara saying it was unfair using slang like pennant that got a rise out of Joe.

Yet Joe was in a good mood, he even showed off a pitch, to only hit the pitcher of water his mother was carrying. The mother and Clara screamed and Joe apologized but it was no big deal in the end.

Joe then explains her actually got invited to St. Louis, a major league team. The family was excited, but the mother was worried why he couldn't play for the local team anymore. Joe explains how drafts work, his mother reminded of war drafts, but he explained it well and that he signed that this could happen.

He was later excited Maple and her husband was coming by train, but even later found out it got snowed in and they might be stuck at least 5 hours.
